title: Round158: bound the value of fleet-resource coupling and test objective levels
head: codex/round158-resource-value-levels
body:
The value of the complete free-fleet resource projection remains unresolved after a substantive hard original-objective level campaign. This study distinguishes inventory-only prices, integer resource witnesses, physical routes, and bare-LP points without changing stable GI-TBC/B or the E+ enhanced reference.

The RX35 hard level **J <= .2519564273646922** completed its full declared **36-hour Native capacity** with all inventory decisions and vehicle assignments free, Seed 0, Threads 1 and MIPFocus 1. It returned normally with **TIME_LIMIT / UNKNOWN**, **258,972 nodes**, **160,559,495 simplex iterations**, Work **318526.526959261**, no integer point and no whole-level exclusion. Native Runtime is 129600.0039999485 seconds; the outer fee is **129601.83248030022 seconds**. Its constant-zero feasibility bound is not an original-J lower. The original root-scope intervals remain unchanged; no novel integer resource upper or physical route is claimed.

The two preselected finite free-assignment queries exclude RX35's retained **Y3 exact-price family (10 members)** and NB35's **singleton** at their original/guarded horizons. Their queried v1/hypot necessary-time lowers are 6310.129749041621 and 7206.982290055626 seconds. An actual C++ duration-coefficient audit verifies identical integer budgets at both nominal and guarded T and transfers those fixed-time exclusions; the old numeric time lowers are not relabeled as identical unconditional C++ minima. Relaxed-time assignments are neither original-T resource uppers nor routes. These family results do not imply a full-level proof or global k-best ordering.

One qualified rounded-budget/subset-dominance expression preserves the integer resource domain and implies the actual raw rows. RX35 reduces from 24,154 to 14,890 rows with 2,673 columns, retaining 4,087 of 7,175 subsets under the common physical/emitted envelope and acceptance horizon. Unequal observed diagnostic node counts demonstrate no compression speedup, so raw received the substantive capacity.

An **exact rational saved point** at Y3 assigns one third of every changed station to each vehicle, with total pickups/drops 56/56 and zero return per vehicle. It satisfies every row and bound of both admitted bare LP matrices, with exact maximum violation zero and 102 fractional integer columns. This documents an ownership-fractionality obstruction. It is **not an integer resource upper, a ceiling on additional integer-valid cuts, or proof of a strict global resource/inventory optimum gap**.

Validation covers actual cutoff omissions/RHS, full original RN preservation (1,467 columns and 2,143 rows), R92 physical-envelope/boundary cases, actual raw/rounded implication, durable normal return/save behavior, exact saved-point readback, finite-family scope/price checks, source/runtime identities and outer accounting. Reviews use separate routines by the same agent; no independent reviewer identity is claimed. R157's log erratum is limited to at least 774 displayed nodes, unfinished Optimize and no invented final NodeCount/Work. All failed and controlled calls and their exact executed source bytes remain.

All **22 scientific outer receipts** are closed at **133396.53870380064 seconds / 259200 seconds (37.054594084389066 hours)**, including failures and necessary readers. Nested Runtime/Work/helper costs are not added twice. The five-page thematic paper compiled twice; all five actual rendered pages were visually inspected. PDF compile/render took **4.410985799971968 seconds**, separately from G1. No new C++ build, production-PE execution, historical producer rerun, E+R candidate or empty conditional eight-arm panel is claimed. The maintained Round137 formal paper continues unchanged.
